summary: Every checkable claim in the report matches check.json, snapshot.json, the rendered pages, the patch and the transcript, and the report openly says that it hit a 500 on its first start and never checked the styling in a browser.

claims.claim: Fetched / and both posts with curl -k, each returned 200, none contains 'Could not render component'
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: all 3 pages status 200 with renderErrors []; the transcript shows the render checks

claims.claim: Block types richTextBlock, imageBlock, calloutBlock in the Blocks folder
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: all three have folder 'Blocks'; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes

claims.claim: 'Blog Body Block Grid' allows the three blocks and is filed under /Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows the data type in folder 'Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid'; grade.md confirms it allows the 3 blocks

claims.claim: blogFrontPage and blogPost are in Pages, each has a blocks property with its own template; siteRoot allows the front page and the front page allows posts
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: folder 'Pages', a blocks property and allowedTemplates on both; siteRoot and blogFrontPage have allowedChildren; check.json schema.blockGridOnPages passes

claims.claim: Blog media folder with four unsplash photos (network-lines-dots, code-on-screen, puzzle-hands, connected-structure)
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 4/4 and content.mediaInFolders pass; grade.md lists the same four

claims.claim: Front page has a rich text block and a callout; each post has title, date, excerpt, listing image and rich text/image/rich text/callout
claims.evidence: pages/*.html, both screenshots and grade.md 'What it built' match

claims.claim: All three pages are published and the domain / is set on the front page
claims.evidence: check.json content.allPublished passes and content.domainAssigned shows 'Blog: /'

claims.claim: Templates, _Layout, 3 adapters, 3 ViewComponents with Default.cshtml, plain models in Models/Blocks
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added lists these files; code.adapterPerBlock and code.viewComponentPerBlock pass

claims.claim: Added two @using lines to _ViewImports.cshtml and dropped the PublishedModels using
claims.evidence: changes.patch removes the PublishedModels using and adds the Models and Models.Blocks usings

claims.claim: dotnet build has 0 warnings and 0 errors; npm run build finished
claims.evidence: check.json build.ok '0 error(s), 0 warning(s)'; code.frontendBuilt shows dist/site.css exists

claims.claim: Four image URLs and site.css return 200
claims.evidence: check.json crawl.assets: 4 images and the CSS all status 200, none external

claims.claim: Front page shows 2 post cards linking to the posts
claims.evidence: check.json site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2; frontpage screenshot shows two cards

claims.claim: First start returned 500 because of Layout = "_Layout.cshtml"; it worked after changing to "_Layout"
claims.evidence: transcript.jsonl shows the 500s with the '_Layout.cshtml' value, then the edit to '_Layout'

claims.claim: Did not view the pages in a browser, so the Tailwind styling is unchecked
claims.evidence: An accurate caveat about what it didn't verify. The screenshots show the styling does render

claims.claim: Backoffice URL and login, site at https://localhost:44317/
claims.evidence: None of the provided artifacts can confirm the port or credentials
